head_commit.message:
Split issue runs: the unit-test steps clear BOS_SPLIT; the suite passes with BOS_SPLIT=true

7dade77 set BOS_SPLIT at job level in the build and verify jobs. The unit-test
step then ran with BOS_SPLIT=true, and the three tests that prepare a one-job
profile raised "a split run needs a split profile" (#99 rerun, run 41494392206).

- submission-check.yml: the two issue unit-test steps set BOS_SPLIT to ''.
- The tests that call prepare() set BOS_SPLIT to '' themselves.
- New test: the full suite runs in a subprocess with BOS_SPLIT=true and passes.
- The workflow test checks the step-level clear in both issue jobs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Snaky smoke fixture: darkhipo/snaky-twenty@f6248dc, bound 20 (issue #106)

Lead, 2026-11-02: darkhipo posted the Snaky package on verifier #106 (20:05Z). smoke.SNAKY_FIXTURE pins it as
the Snaky smoke that must PASS before that problem opens. Like the Subset Sum smoke it runs only on a
maintainer test issue (label test, authored by the dispatcher), test_only, silent, record gate bypassed.
The run clones the author's repository. Snaky stays in CLOSED.

Read-only check of f6248dc (GitHub API and a no-build clone, 2026-11-02; not built on any of our machines):
- One commit. 100 files, 2.44 MB, all mode 100644, no symlinks. The largest file is 650 KB.
- Submission.lean + Submission/ only (11 modules + 81 in Submission/Gen17). Lake files, README, NOTICE and
  LICENSE are outside the source roots.
- Submission/SnakyStatement.lean sha256 49e630b3..., byte-equal to challenges/other-snaky/VerifierStatement.lean.
- Submission.lean: theorem Race.bound : BigOSpeedrun.Snaky.Bound 20 := Snaky.race_bound_20.
- Imports: Submission.* and the 4 Mathlib modules of the statement only. No sorry, axiom, native_decide,
  implemented_by, extern, unsafe, opaque, #eval or elab. The card checks use decide +kernel.
- lean-toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1, Mathlib d13f23b (as the profile's manifest). No set_option except
  maxHeartbeats 0. A heuristic scan of the declaration headers found no use of autoImplicit; the smoke log is the check.
- Apache-2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE.md: the statement copy, the gotrevor card world, the plane bridge).

- docs/execution.md: the smoke form and what to check.
- Tests: SnakySmokeTests (the fixture; dispatch gives one silent entry with the Snaky challenge; another
  bound, commit, label or actor is refused). 233 OK, also with BOS_SPLIT=true.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
